items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did some things with Clyde [phonetic sp.] and -- and his -- his concert band thing that he had.

ctx.x: -- coming out of Vegas and going back to New York City. The quartet that you had at that time, now, did you pretty much stay in the New York City area? That was a group you toured a lot, wasn't it?

No. What I did was I played -- we played -- we op -- we played at the Sweet Basil. Okay? And then I did -- you know, played the Sweet Basil, I did some things with Clyde [phonetic sp.] and -- and his -- his concert band thing that he had.
Was that the World of Trombones or was that something else?
